tasks.subject: H1.1: writing-plans defines a hard dependency
tasks.description:
**Goal:** writing-plans' "Setting Dependencies" states the hard-dependency definition, and its `.tasks.json` example shows a task with no `blockedBy`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md` (section "### Setting Dependencies"; the `.tasks.json` example under "## Task Persistence")
- Create: `tests/parallel-dispatch/test-plan-dependencies.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md` contains the definition from Global Constraints verbatim.
- [ ] The `.tasks.json` example has a third task, `K3.3`, with no `blockedBy`.
- [ ] `bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-plan-dependencies.sh` prints `PASS: all 4 plan-dependency text checks`.

**Verify:** `bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-plan-dependencies.sh` → `PASS: all 4 plan-dependency text checks`

tasks.subject: H1.2: subagent-driven-development dispatches by `blockedBy`
tasks.description:
**Goal:** subagent-driven-development and its references drop the pre-flight dependency ruling and the "two or more tasks ready" trigger; every implementer is dispatched by `parallel-dispatch.md`, by the plan's `blockedBy`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `skills/subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md` (process graph lines 75 and 82; the dispatch bullet at lines 289-292; Bounded Parallel Dispatch lines 425-428)
- Modify: `skills/subagent-driven-development/references/preflight.md` (lines 20-34)
- Modify: `skills/subagent-driven-development/references/parallel-dispatch.md` (opening, rules 1, 2, 4 and 7)
- Modify: `tests/parallel-dispatch/test-skill-text.sh`
- Modify: `tests/parallel-dispatch/test-reference-text.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `grep -rn -E 'dependency ruling|Ruling: dependencies|two or more tasks|overlap is uncertain|two writers on one file|anything about the pair is unclear' skills/subagent-driven-development` prints nothing.
- [ ] `bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-skill-text.sh` prints `PASS`.
- [ ] `bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-reference-text.sh` prints `PASS`.

**Verify:** `bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-skill-text.sh && bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-reference-text.sh` → two `PASS` lines
